content.short: UTYABSWAP BRIDGE lets users swap, bridge, stake, and access fiat exchange features around TON.
content.description: UTYABSWAP BRIDGE is the bridge-oriented side of the UtyabSwap product. Its public description covers swaps, bridging, staking, fiat exchange, and other TON workflows in one app. The bridge entry is for users moving assets into or out of TON while keeping access to adjacent DeFi actions. Swap, bridge, stake, fiat exchange and more on TON. UTYABSWAP BRIDGE belongs with DeFi tooling because it helps users or developers understand, move, or connect assets across protocols. The registry value is the tooling layer it adds around bridges, analytics, routing, or cross-chain movement.
